title: GenAI as a runaway object in higher education: A socio-cultural view on AI-influenced academic practice in mathematics
why: Uses Engestrom's activity theory to treat GenAI as a runaway object that reconfigures roles, tools and boundaries across teaching and research. A systems reading that fits the complexity line you are taking to CARN.
caveat: One mathematics department in one institution. The runaway-object framing is suggestive rather than measured.
source: Journal watch: Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence
